items.title: MRMPO 2035 Metropolitan Transportation Plan - Complete Plan and Appendices
items.description: Preserves the complete 2035 regional plan and appendices, documenting growth forecasts, multimodal needs, project priorities, financial constraints, environmental analysis, public involvement, and amendments adopted through May 2014.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 348-page PDF preserved without modification.
Adopted April 15, 2011; federally approved June 30, 2011; amended December 14, 2012 and May 16, 2014.
Complete plan-and-appendices edition retained as the canonical 2035 regional planning record.

items.title: MRMPO Futures 2040 Metropolitan Transportation Plan
items.description: Establishes the region's 2040 transportation direction through growth scenarios, multimodal system needs, project and funding strategies, safety, environmental considerations, performance measures, and a September 2017 administrative modification.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 371-page PDF preserved without modification.
Adopted April 17, 2015; includes the administrative modification adopted September 15, 2017.
Main plan retained with the separately published authoritative appendices.

items.title: MRMPO Futures 2040 Metropolitan Transportation Plan - Appendices
items.description: Preserves project lists, scenario and safety methods, emissions analysis, long-range system guidance, outreach, funding projections, maintenance assumptions, performance monitoring, and the September 2017 Appendix A modification.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 311-page PDF preserved without modification.
Contains Appendices A-P and the administrative modification to Appendix A adopted September 15, 2017.
Published separately by MRCOG and retained beside the main Futures 2040 plan.

items.title: MRMPO Connections 2040 Metropolitan Transportation Plan
items.description: Preserves the complete 2020 regional plan covering demographic and travel trends, land-use scenarios, roadway, transit, bicycle and pedestrian networks, safety, freight, resilience, finance, and implementation.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 348-page PDF preserved without modification.
The 59,514,796-byte file is unusually large because it is the complete illustrated plan with detailed maps, tables, and graphics.
Smaller authoritative chapter files exist, but none alone preserves the complete plan; no optimization is proposed because fidelity and unified historical access are valuable.
items.large_file_assessment: 59,514,796-byte PDF (56.76 MiB). It is unusually large because the 348-page complete plan includes detailed maps, tables, and graphics. Smaller authoritative chapter files exist, but no smaller file contains the complete plan. Optimization is technically possible but is not proposed because it would modify the authoritative source and reduce archival fidelity.

items.title: Connections 2040 Appendix A: Metropolitan Transportation Plan Project List
items.description: Lists funded, near-term, and long-term regional bicycle, pedestrian, roadway, preservation, safety, operations, and transit projects, with locations, descriptions, lead agencies, planning costs, and anticipated timeframes.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 63-page PDF preserved without modification.
Retained separately because the project inventory is a high-value historical reference for tracing Albuquerque-area proposals and implementation.
Also contained in the complete Connections 2040 plan; the standalone official appendix materially improves focused access.

items.title: Connections 2040 Appendix E: Long-Range Transportation System Guidelines - 2020 Update
items.description: Preserves the 2020 regional guidance for land-use context, multimodal networks, roadway design, right-of-way, intersections, traffic calming, bicycle and pedestrian infrastructure, road diets, and performance measures.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 102-page PDF preserved without modification.
Retained as the historical predecessor to the separately archived June 2026 Long-Range Transportation System Guide.
Also contained in the complete Connections 2040 plan; the standalone official appendix supports design-guidance lineage research.
